title: Ingadi Yafunga Ekuseni
intro: Emahoreni okuthula ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga, kwenziwa icebo ngasese. Ifa elichumayo lalilungele ukuvunwa, kodwa kwaba yisinqumo sokugcina zonke izithelo kude nalabo abaswele. Ekuseni, konke kwakuzobonakala kungajwayelekile, futhi isifundo sasizoba amagatsha amnyama kubo bonke abacabangayo.
clues: Sazuza ifa lensimu echumayo futhi safunga ukuthi sizovuna zonke izithelo zayo.
Safunga ukuphuma ekuseni kakhulu ngesikhathi abampofu abacela isabelo sabo besalele.
Sasusa noma yikuphi okuhlukile esifungweni sethu futhi sagodla ilungelo labaswele ngaphandle kokusho ukuthi u-Allah uyathanda yini.
Saphuma sihlebelana ukuze singavumeli muntu ompofu ukuba angene engadini yethu ngalolo suku.
Sazibona singakwazi ngokugcwele ukuqoqa konke nokuvimbela noma ubani oqoqa ukudla ukuba angadli ingxenye.
Savuka sathola ingadi yethu yonakele ebusuku, imnyama sengathi ivuniwe, sathi siswele futhi siphendukile.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
